summary.name: Cave Wall Painting
summary.visualIdentity: Red/ochre and charcoal animal outlines and hand marks follow an uneven rock surface. Pores and irregular pigment edges belong to the material. Cartoon outlines, neon glow and decorative pseudo-inscriptions are excluded.
summary.suitableUses: Use cases are unspecified in the metadata. Inferred fit: textured, ancient-wall or primitive-art themes where rock relief and gradual pigment reveal carry the mood.
summary.limitations: Rock and pigment are a procedural approximation, not archaeological footage, so disclosure is required on screen or in credits. Lighting is approximate. The source review sampled only 1–8 second frames.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent; #AF845A is an illustrative swatch only. Fallback tokens: foreground #2B211A, ochre #C49B6B, red #984B32, charcoal #3B2B21, chalk #DDD0B4. Approved task or reference colors override them. Use no gradient, and check text contrast against a 4.5:1 target.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Preview timing: short pigment strokes reveal over 0–1.8 seconds, then a slow light sweep crosses the fixed rock from 1.8–3.0 seconds. Interactivity is unspecified. GSAP tweens shader uniforms synchronously from shared time for seekable playback.
summary.audio: Audio is not specified in the metadata. Options include music, voiceover, ambience or silence, chosen per task. No historical soundtrack is assumed, and no audio asset is supplied or verified.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads are required; procedural generation is the default. Optional inputs are an approved rock photo as albedo (disclosed as composited), authored pigment frame sequences or transparent hand marks, and offline NumPy/Pillow height and stroke-order maps.
summary.combinations: Optional secondary example: style-021, with its role unspecified. Keep this medium dominant, preserve approved colors, and use one owner per animated property. Avoid generic effects that replace mark-making and any invented historical text.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: Three.js WebGLRenderer with a fixed orthographic quad, GLSL ShaderMaterial and Canvas 2D pigment strokes. Motion: GSAP tweens uniforms. Pipeline: HyperFrames by default, with Remotion only for a verified limitation. chroma-js is optional for contrast checks. Bloom is rejected. Runtime availability is unverified.
